python3 -c "
import cv2
import numpy as np
import math

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0091.png')
# Frame 90 was (0.200, 3.256, 240 deg)
# Move 0.5 along 240 deg:
cam_x = 0.200 + 0.5 * math.sin(math.radians(240))
cam_y = 3.256 + 0.5 * math.cos(math.radians(240))
theta_deg = 240.0
theta_rad = math.radians(theta_deg)
print(f'Pose at frame 91: ({cam_x:.3f}, {cam_y:.3f}, {theta_deg:.1f} deg)')

mask_pot = (img[:, :, 2] > 140) & (img[:, :, 0] < 50) & (img[:, :, 1] < 100)
ys, xs = np.where(mask_pot)
if len(ys) > 0:
    v_bot = np.max(ys)
    u_c = np.mean(xs[ys == v_bot])
    u_min, u_max = np.min(xs), np.max(xs)
    print(f'Pot bottom: v={v_bot}, u_center={u_c:.1f}, u_span=({u_min}, {u_max})')
    Z_c = 1.55 / ((v_bot - 256.0) / 256.0)
    X_c = ((u_c - 256.0) / 256.0) * Z_c
    wx = cam_x + Z_c * math.sin(theta_rad) + X_c * math.cos(theta_rad)
    wy = cam_y + Z_c * math.cos(theta_rad) - X_c * math.sin(theta_rad)
    print(f'Pot base in world: ({wx:.3f}, {wy:.3f})')
"
